## How it works

- [statement] The mongodb/atlas-billing README deprecates its Realm-based billing-dashboard implementation because Charts supplies the feature natively. A September 2022 community answer still points to that older repository; it is historical guidance. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-billing · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards · also: https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/rest-api-to-get-billing-related-data-clusters-which-is-being-used/187680

(low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-billing · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Creationline’s January 12, 2024 pricing guide describes Charts transfer-based charges with a 1 GB monthly free allowance; MongoDB’s cached Data Transfer documentation describes the same allowance. This does not establish a current all-in operating cost for a billing dashboard. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.creationline.com/tech-blog/data-management/mongodb/69164 · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/admin-settings.md
- [statement] Creationline's January 12, 2024 cost-estimation article describes Charts charges in terms of data transfer and a monthly 1 GB free allowance. This is historical pricing context, not verified current billing policy. (low confidence) (verified as of 2024-01-12) — https://www.creationline.com/tech-blog/data-management/mongodb/69164 · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards
- [statement] Official Charts documentation is inconsistent on charging: release notes announce free Charts access for paid/Flex clusters, while Data Transfer documentation still describes a 1 GB monthly allowance and charges after it is exceeded. Current applicability needs clarification. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/release-notes.md · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/admin-settings.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Atlas Charts supports customizable billing dashboards for tracking database expenses. Its prebuilt charts cover organization totals, biggest spenders, and spending by instance size, project, cluster, product category, and SKU. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards · also: https://livebook.manning.com/book/mongodb-in-action-third-edition/chapter-19/v-5, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/billing-data.md
- [statement] Charts uses the Invoices API to ingest twelve months of billing data initially, then ingests data daily. A dashboard refresh should not be interpreted as a new billing ingestion. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards
- [statement] Dashboard history covers twelve months. Adding linked invoices to an existing ingestion loads three months of linked history; a new ingestion loads twelve. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards
- [statement] Invoice corrections propagate after the next scheduled ingestion only for invoices incurred within the last three months. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards
- [statement] Creation requires Project Data Access Read/Write; setup requests organization API keys and a destination database. Default filter fields are name, cluster, category, and sku; tags can support custom charts. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards
- [statement] Charts release notes record a billing-ingestion payload-size fix in v1.45.0 (July 4, 2024) and a missing-line-items fix for invoices older than three months in v1.47.0 (October 27, 2024). These entries describe fixed historical bugs. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/release-notes.md · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards
- [statement] Charts visualization refresh and invoice ingestion have separate schedules: pricing documentation permits one-minute dashboard refresh for Flex/dedicated projects, while billing ingestion documentation specifies daily imports. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/pricing.md · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md
- [statement] Atlas Charts offers prebuilt billing dashboards that users can customize after ingesting Atlas billing data. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards · also: https://livebook.manning.com/book/mongodb-in-action-third-edition/chapter-19/v-5
- [statement] Native setup selects an organization, organization API keys, a target deployment and database. Creation requires Project Data Access Read/Write; the documentation lists Organization Billing Admin and Organization Billing Viewer for the key pair. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards
- [statement] Billing dashboards use the latest twelve months. Changed invoices update only within the documented three-month correction window and appear after the next scheduled ingestion. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards
- [statement] Enabling linked invoices on an existing ingestion imports three months from each linked organization; enabling them on a new ingestion imports twelve months. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards
- [statement] The official pricing page distinguishes M0 feature limits from Flex/dedicated features: M0 dashboards auto-refresh every four hours and lack manual refresh, while Flex/dedicated support refresh intervals down to one minute. These rendering settings do not establish billing-ingestion frequency. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/pricing.md · keywords: MongoDB Charts billing dashboards
